name: bone morphogenetic protein receptor type 1A
pathways: positive regulation of SMAD protein signal transduction

function.text: BMPR1A encodes bone morphogenetic protein receptor type-1A. Annotated molecular activities include protein serine/threonine kinase activity and transmembrane receptor protein serine/threonine kinase activity. It participates in positive regulation of miRNA transcription and positive regulation of SMAD protein signal transduction.

germline.text: Retained constitutional disease associations include juvenile polyposis syndrome (autosomal dominant); generalized juvenile polyposis/juvenile polyposis coli (autosomal dominant). Pathogenicity and inheritance depend on the specific allele and disorder.

somatic.text: Somatic sequence alterations have cohort-level candidate-driver evidence in Stomach Adenocarcinoma. This gene-level statistical evidence requires allele-specific review and does not establish the effect of every variant.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
